core_coverage.answer_quote: Soraka moves faster toward nearby allied champions at low health.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the movement-speed benefit, direction, nearby ally requirement and low-health condition.

core_coverage.answer_quote: A star lands at the target location, dealing magic damage and slowing enemies hit.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the targeted area, magic damage and slow.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation: healing over time and bonus movement speed that fades.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the champion-hit trigger and both Rejuvenation benefits. This general description does not explicitly promise immediate or uninterrupted delivery.

core_coverage.answer_quote: While she has Rejuvenation, Astral Infusion also grants it to the target ally.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the supported Rejuvenation-sharing condition and effect.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Soraka heals another allied champion, normally spending some of her own health.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the allied recipient and normal health cost without asserting that the full cost must always be payable.

core_coverage.answer_quote: While she has Rejuvenation, Astral Infusion costs less health and also grants Rejuvenation to the ally.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both reduced health cost and sharing. A fully removed health cost is consistent with costing less health.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Soraka creates a zone that silences enemies inside.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the zone and its silence.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Enemy champions still inside when it expires are rooted.
core_coverage.reason: Explains the expiration trigger and remaining-inside condition using the champion scope supported by both sources.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Enemy champions in the zone take magic damage when it appears and again when it erupts.
core_coverage.reason: Explains both separate magic-damage events and their champion targets.

core_coverage.answer_quote: Soraka instantly heals herself and all allied champions, regardless of distance.
core_coverage.reason: Explains immediate healing, self and allied recipients, and global reach.
Explains the low-health healing bonus without unsupported numeric precision.

conflicts.resolution: The draft preserves the delayed-root core using enemy champions, the shared supported scope. Root behavior for other enemy units remains unresolved and requires QA only if broader wording is desired.
conflicts.topic: Equinox root target scope: Riot says all enemies; the Wiki explicitly describes enemy champions.

factual_risks: This check assesses supplied textual evidence only; it is neither human approval nor visual verification.
Evidence is pinned to Data Dragon 16.21.1 and Wiki revision 3892689; current-client behavior and a live patch label are not established.
The passive arrow description is textually supported by wiki:P, but the supplied demonstration frames do not establish current-client or skin-specific visuals.

Q's general Rejuvenation description omits supported delivery and interception details. It must not be interpreted as guaranteeing immediate receipt; sharing can begin before Soraka receives the returning projectile.
W's supported low-health casting restriction and health-cost exceptions are omitted beginner details, not contradicted by its qualified normal-cost description.
The excerpts include map-specific differences and a reported immediate-respawn Wish bug; the draft makes no precise cost, scaling or cooldown promises affected by those details.
AP as a learning focus is supported by supplied healing and damage ratios, but those ratios do not establish an optimal build.
No internal provenance, confidence or development labels appear in the card-facing answers, counterplay or passive description; such labels remain in metadata.
